title: Negotiating a Higher Salary
paragraphs: After two years without a raise, Yousef spent an entire week preparing evidence of his contributions before finally requesting a meeting with his manager to discuss his current compensation directly.
During the meeting, he presented specific numbers and completed projects instead of simply saying he deserved more, which made his manager take the request noticeably more seriously than expected.
His manager needed a week to consult with upper management, leaving Yousef anxiously waiting, unsure whether his direct approach had been the right decision or an unnecessary risk.

When the raise was finally approved, slightly lower than his original request but still meaningful, Yousef learned that presenting a clear case mattered more than simply hoping to be noticed eventually.
